summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.03/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.03 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 13, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 30. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.17 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.72) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.29).
